The circular supplies neither a measurement date nor rules for classification after later threshold changes. The assessment-time convention does not establish those legal rules.
The three missing dependency IDs have no supplied authority mappings. They cannot safely be assigned to named external authorities.
A conflict anywhere in the dependency closure blocks even an otherwise established designation route. This is an explicit operational restriction, not a rule stated by the circular.
